Dear Adatum Ltd,

Your request for a reshipping fee refund (£175) for ticket **C-4463** has been processed successfully. The refund will appear in your account within **3–5 business days**.

**Additional Updates:**
- The hardware was shipped to the correct location (**Leeds DC**) as requested.
- If you do not see the refund within 10 days, please reply to this email or contact our support team at **support@adatum.ltd**.

Thank you for your patience.

Regards,
**IT Operations Team**
Adatum Ltd
